concepts.def: Change in measurement per unit time
Half the resolution of the instrument

walkthroughs.body_html:
Rate = change ÷ time.

40 cm³ in 20 s → 40 ÷ 20 = 2 cm³/s. Always state units.

Potato chip 5.0 g → 5.5 g. % change = (5.5 − 5.0) ÷ 5.0 × 100 = +10%.

Positive = gain; negative = loss.

If a ruler reads to 1 mm, the uncertainty is ±0.5 mm.

A measurement of 50.0 ± 0.5 mm is the form OCR wants. The % uncertainty = 0.5 ÷ 50 × 100 = 1%.
